title: Tell Claude the product, ad angle, and desired ad length to generate a full UGC…
content:
Tell Claude the product, ad angle, and desired ad length to generate a full UGC script plus a scene-by-scene shot list you can use as Seedance prompts  
Have Claude write a GPT Image 2.0 prompt to generate an AI creator from scratch, then use that character as the consistent reference for Seedance 2.0  
Generate per-scene prompts that include dialogue lines and delivery direction, then run them as separate scenes in Seedance 2.0  
In Seedance 2.0, lock character + product + voice to maintain consistency across all scenes  
Use your actual product photo as a reference input to improve product fidelity in Seedance 2.0  
After generating in Seedance 2.0, speed up the clips and add captions in CapCut to finish the ad quickly

Haz que Claude escriba un prompt de GPT Image 2.0 para generar un creador de IA desde cero, luego usa ese personaje como referencia constante para Seedance 2.0

En Seedance 2.0, bloquea personaje + producto + voz para mantener la consistencia en todas las escenas  
Usa la foto real de tu producto como entrada de referencia para mejorar la fidelidad del producto en Seedance 2.0
